name: L&T Technology Services Ltd
title: L&T Technology Services Ltd - 540115 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 USD revenue $305.9Mn (+0.3% YoY, -1.7% QoQ) after portfolio pruning; EBIT margin 15.2% with mid-16% target pulled to Q4FY27 or earlier, but no annual guidance and no capacity signals.

triggers.label: Mid-16% EBIT margin by Q4FY27 or prior
triggers.quote: we now advance our aspiration to achieve mid-16% EBIT margin levels on or before Q4FY27

triggers.label: Mobility revenue growth expected from Q1
triggers.quote: Mobility has stabilized this quarter. You will start seeing growth from next quarter.

triggers.label: Pruned $19Mn annualised low-margin work
triggers.quote: we are talking about $19 Mn annualized that we are taking out. That has been taken out in Q4.

triggers.label: Headcount +522 QoQ to 23,830
triggers.quote: Headcount improved sequentially by 522 to 23,830 at year-end as we onboarded freshers during the quarter.

guidance.quote: we now advance our aspiration to achieve mid-16% EBIT margin levels on or before Q4FY27
we aspire to deliver 13% -15% CAGR over the next 5 years with EBIT margins in the range of 16% -17%
with EBIT margins in the range of 16% -17%
The combined DSO is expected to be in the range of 85-90 days going forward.
we expect this to be in the range of 26.5% to 27%

red_flags.label: Growth below 13-15% target; FY26 organic growth flagged as lagging
red_flags.quote: we are not providing any annual guidance

red_flags.label: Management declined to quantify timing and retreated from annual guidance
red_flags.quote: Again, can I take the fifth and say I don't know. See we'll see.

evasions.quote: we are not providing any annual guidance. So, I'm not going to fish in the waters of what will be next year.
What we can do, Dipesh, maybe we'll have Sandesh talk to you offline
